senses.gloss:
(III)--a name of ब्रह्मा
1: भा. VIII. 5. २४; Br. III. २१. ५९.
(s.v.). He created a daughter शतरूपा (सावित्री); she was so charming that he himself fell in love with her; her brothers like वसिष्ठ and she herself deplored the absurdity of a father marrying his daughter; the creator turned a deaf ear and all his attention became centred on her; to see her wherever she was he created more eyes on all his five faces; after order- ing his sons to take up the work of creation, he lived with शतरूपा for years in the midst of the lotus flower unseen by others, like an ordinary human being. To him was born Manu स्वायम्भुव also known as विराट् and आदिपुरुष; from him were born the वैराज devas and others;
2: M. 3. २९ to the end.
grand- father of all the worlds.
3: वा. १०६. ४०; १०८. ४२; १०९. २६.
--a hell for the maker of arrows. Vi. II. 6. १६.
--a मन्त्रकृत् and of Angira branch. M. १४५. ९९; वा. ५९. ९८.
